maya: pushed fixes for the telemetry edge case and addressed the comments about null/empty streams. added a unit test and a short integration smoke harness. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/842
kevin: thanks — looking now
kevin: quick q: are we gating the change behind a flag or making it default?
maya: added an env flag as discussed so it's opt-in for now. config example:
```
TELEMETRY_IGNORE_EMPTY=true
```
kevin: got it. makes sense to keep it gated until we validate with canary
andre: ran the test matrix locally and kicked CI; one flaky telemetry backfill test failed but reran and it passed :white_check_mark:
maya: rebased on main and squashed. updated changelog entry per request. can someone with merge perms schedule canary tomorrow morning and give a quick smoke pass? tagging @release-ops
release-bot: canary slot scheduled for 2025-11-12 09:00 UTC — job id rwd-canary-20251112-09
